newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil corruption figure jailed for wife's murder.
newsitem.headline: Brazil corruption figure jailed for wife's murder.

text.p: A former Brazilian Congress official, who revealed a major corruption scandal involving lawmakers in 1993, was sentenced to 20 years in jail on Friday for the murder of his wife, officials said.

Jose Carlos Alves dos Santos was convicted of hiring a private detective and a mechanic to kill Ana Elizabeth dos Santos. Her body was found in a shallow grave near Brasilia after the two assassins confessed their role in the crime.

A jury in a court in Planaltina, near the Brazilian capital, rejected claims by defence lawyers that Ana Elizabeth was murdered by members of Congress involved in the corruption scandal because she was going to reveal the scam.
Dos Santos, a former adviser to a budget committee in Congress, told police of the multi-million dollar bribery ring when he was arrested for his wife's murder four years ago.
A subsequent congressional inquiry resulted in the suspension of several members of Congress and the resignation of a minister. The scandal also halted a review of Brazil's constitution.
